title: Should I buy it?
description: AI WebApp to help you make better spending decisions based on your financial background and profile.
features: 90 days liquidity curve - Calculates exact daily cash balances by harmonizing your recurring payday cycles with fixed monthly obligations like rent, utilities, and debt payments over next 90 days.
Emergency buffer defence - Enforces your sacred reserve floor. If a prospective purchase causes your liquid funds to dip below your safety threshold at any point, the model flags it immediately.
Risk detection - Enforces your sacred reserve floor. If a prospective purchase causes your liquid funds to dip below your safety threshold at any point, the model flags it immediately.
Privacy first workflow - Gives the option to keep everything private and local or have a cloud backup with a logged in account.
AI Powered Insights - Advanced financial insights and recommendations based on your spending habits, income patterns, and financial goals.
Flexible Input Options - Accepts recurring payments (salary, rent) as well as one-time transactions.
Logged Querey History - Track your spending patterns through the logged history of your purchase queries.
